title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 518 North Ridgewood Drive in Sebring, Florida, as the "U.S. Army Air Corps Major Thomas B. McGuire Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 518 North Ridgewood Drive in Sebring, Florida, as the U.S. Army Air Corps Major Thomas B. McGuire Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A federal law renames a Postal Service building in Sebring, Florida, after Major Thomas B. McGuire, a World War II-era Army Air Corps pilot.
summary.what_it_does: This act officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 518 North Ridgewood Drive in Sebring, Florida, the U.S. Army Air Corps Major Thomas B. McGuire Post Office Building. It changes only the name used for that building in federal law and does not change how the post office operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 2, 2025, and the naming took effect on that date.
